title: People in Your Life
goal: By the end of the lesson, you can describe people you know and explain how you feel about them.
today: Two to four sentences is enough

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

items.vi: người quen, chưa phải bạn thân
items.def: someone you know, but not well
someone who is hard to deal with

items.q: Mai always does what she promises. She's very ______.
Ben is relaxed and rarely gets upset. He's quite ______.
Linh notices when other people need help. She's very ______.
I know James from a course, but we aren't close friends. He's an ______.

vocab.text: Đáp án: 1 reliable · 2 easy-going · 3 considerate · 4 acquaintance. Which clue helped you choose each word? Gạch chân từ gợi ý trước khi chọn.
Trả lời trước khi xem đáp án. Sau đó kể tên một người thật khớp với một tính từ.

items.def: Do you know this person very well? — No
Can people depend on this person? — Yes
Does this person think about other people's feelings? — Yes
Does this person usually stay relaxed? — Yes

items.q: I really like my new manager. We ______ each other very well.
I ______ people who interrupt all the time. It drives me crazy.
The noise is annoying, but I can ______ it for another hour.
We used to be close, but we gradually ______ each other after graduation.

vocab.text: Đáp án: 1 get along with · 2 can't stand · 3 put up with · 4 lost touch with. Chú ý dạng quá khứ lost.

head: Expression
What follows
Natural example
rows: I can't stand loud music. / I can't stand waiting.
I can't put up with the noise.
I get along with most of my colleagues.
I lost touch with an old classmate.
I find it easy to talk to her.

vocab.text: Tập trung vào dạng đi sau mỗi cụm. Drill thay thế: people who complain · waiting in traffic · loud neighbours · a former colleague.

head: Pattern
Example
Use
rows: I like people who listen carefully.
mệnh đề quan hệ tả người
I find it easy to talk to her.
What I like most is her honesty.

grammar.text: Học như khung nói, không phải bài giảng ngữ pháp. Chọn 2 mẫu và đặt 1 câu thật với mỗi mẫu.
Chọn 1 mẫu yêu thích từ mỗi nhóm. Tránh dùng nhiều connector trong một câu trả lời ngắn.
She's quite easy-going, and she communicates very clearly.
Answer building · Two to four sentences

items.label: 1 · ANSWER
items.text: I can't stand unnecessary meetings.

items.label: 2 · REASON
items.text: They waste a lot of time.

items.label: 3 · EXAMPLE
items.text: For example, some meetings could be replaced with a short email.

items.label: 4 · CONTRAST
items.text: However, I don't mind meetings that have a clear purpose.

grammar.text: Dừng sau câu 2, 3 hoặc 4 khi câu trả lời đã đủ. Không cần đủ 4 tầng cho mọi câu hỏi.

reading.text: Honestly, I can't stand unnecessary meetings. They waste a lot of time mainly because nothing gets decided. For example, some meetings could be replaced with a short email. However, I don't mind meetings that have a clear purpose. In my experience, a short agenda makes a meeting worth the time.

items.q: Câu nào nêu quan điểm chính?
Câu nào nêu lý do?
Câu nào cho ví dụ?
Câu nào thể hiện tương phản?
Từ nào mở đầu câu trả lời tự nhiên?

reading.text: Chọn 2 câu hỏi. Dùng 1 target expression và 1 language lift. Cho 10 giây chuẩn bị, trả lời 2–4 câu. Đối tác phản hồi và hỏi 1 câu nối tiếp. Đổi vai sau câu 1.

conversations.title: A new colleague
conversations.lift: find it easy to… · surprisingly well

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: How are things with your new colleague?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Pretty good. She's very reliable, and I find it easy to talk to her. We have quite a lot in common, so we get along surprisingly well.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: That's nice. What do you have in common?

check: What two qualities does Emma mention?
Why do Emma and her colleague get along?
Which expression means 'talking to her does not feel difficult'?
What follow-up question keeps the conversation going?
conversations.answers: 1 reliable and easy to talk to · 2 they have a lot in common · 3 find it easy to talk to her · 4 surprisingly · 5 What do you have in common?
conversations.note: Đọc to trước khi xem slide nếu có thể. Hỏi: Why does Emma like working with her colleague? Which words make the answer more detailed?

conversations.title: A difficult person

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Is there anything you can't stand at work?

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Honestly, I can't stand people who constantly interrupt others. I can put up with it once or twice, but it becomes really frustrating when it happens in every meeting. However, I try to react calmly.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I know what you mean. How do you handle it?

check: I can't stand waiting in long lines. — noun hay V-ing?
I put up with the noise for two hours. — nghĩa là tolerated hay enjoyed?
People who interrupt others annoy me. — mệnh đề quan hệ hay câu hỏi?
I try to react calmly. — adjective hay adverb?
conversations.answers: 1 V-ing · 2 tolerated · 3 mệnh đề quan hệ · 4 adverb
conversations.note: Nhận xét: câu trả lời giữ một chủ đề. Chú ý who constantly interrupt others là mệnh đề quan hệ, react calmly là verb + adverb.

roleplay.title: Meeting an old friend
roleplay.context: You meet an old friend after several years apart.
steps: Ask who they still keep in touch with.
Talk about someone you both knew.
Describe what that person was like.
Mention someone you lost touch with.
Say whether you would like to reconnect.
roleplay.useful: keep in touch with · lose touch with · acquaintance · easy-going · reliable

roleplay.title: A colleague
roleplay.context: A colleague asks how you feel about working with different people.
steps: COLLEAGUE: Ask what kind of person is easy to work with.
YOU: Describe two qualities and explain why.
COLLEAGUE: Ask about one difficult behaviour.
YOU: Use can't stand or put up with. Give an example.
COLLEAGUE: React and share a similar experience.
roleplay.useful: easy-going · considerate · can't stand · put up with · get along with

finalTask.text: Final mission · Talk about people naturally
Talk about people in your work or daily life. Describe someone you get along with. Mention one behaviour you can't stand or have to put up with. Ask your partner at least two related questions.
A conversation grows through short, relevant turns.
Feedback focus: chọn từ phù hợp, 1 language lift thành công, và tương tác. Không đếm mọi lỗi ngữ pháp trong lúc nói.
Choose 6 target expressions. Write one true sentence with each.
What kind of people do you find easy or difficult to get along with? Include one reason, one example, and one sentence with who or that.

items: can't stand + V-ing — KHÔNG dùng can't stand + to V
find it + ADJ + to V — không nói 'I find easy to talk to her'
put up with (chịu đựng) ≠ get along with (hòa hợp)
WHO + V khi người làm chủ ngữ; THAT dùng được cho cả người và vật
lose touch with — chú ý dạng quá khứ bất quy tắc: lose → lost
